gaps.description: What the Custom section of the properties panel, the general style and attribute editor, cannot write: SVG and MathML attributes.

A stored event handler attribute is a string of code, so both renderers drop it on purpose (blockedNodes.ts). A cell here means no stored action ran from a real cause: the note says why, and the published page and the format already run most of them (events.score.ts). The canvas asks the same on the mounted editor in the Interact tool; the panel column still waits for slice B11. In the AI column the cell asks whether the generator keeps the proof's stored trigger, and fails here when it does not.
The AI generator validator refuses this tag on purpose: blocked in every renderer, or a raw form control, which only works through the form presets.
The tag picker of the Custom section does not offer SVG and MathML elements.

What the render gate refuses (blockedNodes.ts and renderVocabulary.ts): embedded content (iframe, object, embed, ...), although these are ordinary content elements, and attributes that act by themselves (ping, the shadow root ones).

A trigger the model writes itself runs on a person's click, key or input only, and never waits (`delay`) or fires another trigger (`emit`): a trigger on load, on scroll into view, on focus, on a media or animation event or on a custom event is refused to the generator, so nothing it writes runs without a person. A safety decision from the security review of slice B12, see "Decided in slice B12" in the behaviour model plan. Presets keep their own triggers.
CSS that applies to the document rather than a node (view transitions, `@page`, `@layer`): the route owns `html`. A rule on `:root` on the page root is the one form held today.

A head item of a page or a site (a meta name, a property, a link rel, JSON-LD; docs/plans/2026-11-02-theme-and-head.md). Stored and published (slice H2); the panel waits for slice H3, and the canvas has no counterpart: a head tag has nothing to draw in the editor, so that cell stays here and says so.
Behaviour and state: no way to say that one element changes another.
A promise of the reusable component format (an input type, a placement, a state or an interaction) that this surface does not keep yet.
An HTML attribute whose name is also a CSS property (width, height) is read as a style, so the editor loses the attribute: a canvas bitmap size or an image size hint is not the same as a declaration.
The AI generator validator refuses this attribute on purpose, or a tree lost a raw form control (see the tag gap).

A rule that reads what a visitor does or looks beyond its node: stored and rendered, but refused to the generator on purpose, because a generation must not be able to report a visitor. See "AI output" in the selector styling plan.

A head item the generator may not write: a generation has no field for one, and anything it carries beyond its nodes is dropped, so a model cannot add a verification tag, an alternate link or structured data to a site. Decided in the theme and head contract (Score changes): the AI column of the 33 head rows is refused on purpose, and a cell here means the generator still drops it.
React drops or rewrites an attribute that is valid HTML.
Text mixed with elements: text beside an element is lost or lands out of order.

The contract, or the stored action of an event row, passes on the published page but not on the mounted editor in the Interact tool, the canvas mode where the page runs in its frames. The note says what stopped it: the editor surfaces drop `popover`, `popovertarget` and `commandfor`, a frame has no scroller of its own, and the panels sit where a page would scroll.
JSX that is a program, not markup: reported as left over by the static import, as the plan requires.
CSS that needs a selector (states, pseudo-elements, structural selectors): a node only holds inline declarations, so no rule can be written.

The site's colour mode and its document defaults: stored, published, drawn and edited, but refused to the generator on purpose. A token applies to every page of the site and a brief is about one, so the generator may use a token and add one, and has no field for the mode or the page defaults. See "What the AI may read and write" in the theme and head plan.

A pseudo-element drawn in the top layer, above every z-index and so above the consent banner (src/lib/styles/stacking.ts): a styled `::picker(select)` covers the screen, and in WebKit no tap closes it. Every path refuses it on purpose.
A construct that cannot survive nodes to JSX and back, because the format has nowhere to put it.
A stored value a renderer refuses, overwrites or loses.

Motion a generation may not start: an `every` trigger is refused to the generator, so nothing it makes rotates or ticks by itself unasked. A safety decision, see "AI output" in the behaviour model plan.
The AI generator validator keeps the property but refuses this value.
